title: NSLS Speaker Broadcast Quote
description: A single quotable statement extracted from an NSLS Speaker Broadcast transcript.

id.description: Unique identifier in the format YYYY-MM-DD-NNN (date added + sequence number).

speaker.description: Full name of the person being quoted (the guest speaker, not the host).

text.description: The exact reconstructed quote text. Should be a complete, self-contained thought of at least ~25 words. Do not paraphrase.
text.example: You have to be willing to fail. If you are not willing to fail, you are not going to succeed.

episode.description: The name of the Speaker Broadcast episode this quote came from.

date.description: Year (or full date if known) of the broadcast.

sourceFile.description: Exact filename of the transcript file in Google Drive that this quote was extracted from.

themes.description: 2–5 theme tags that describe what this quote is about. Used for filtering and search.

addedDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this quote was added to the database.
